Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Endel's pricing idle - a sleeping dark moon mascot with closed eyes and two small hands breathes above the clouds, emitting drifting sparkle particles, over the "70% off 1 Year / 3 Months of Endel Premium" offer and plan rows.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Black pricing screen: the offer title top, the mascot (dark sphere, shut eyes, tiny hands cupping a glowing speck) floating mid-screen over gray cloud layers, plan options and purchase details below, X top-right.

## Motion spec
Pattern: breathing mascot with particle drift.
- The mascot's body slowly swells and settles (scale 1 <-> 1.04, ~3.5s, smooth sine) - a sleeping breath; its hands rise and fall with it.
- The speck between the hands glows (opacity 0.6 <-> 1, 1.8s) and sheds tiny sparkle particles that float upward ~60px over 2-3s, fading as they rise (spawn every ~400ms, randomized lateral drift).
- The cloud layer drifts laterally at a crawl (translate +-8px, 8s loop).
- Screen entrance: the title fades in, the mascot scales up from 0.85 with a soft spring (~260/22), clouds and plan rows fade up staggered (120ms apart).

## Calibration
- Everything loops gently; nothing ever snaps or stops - this screen idles indefinitely.
- Monochrome with one warm glow point (the speck) - that single light is the focus.

## Reduced motion
Mascot static; particles hidden.

## Don't miss
- The mascot's closed eyes and slow breath sell "sleep brand" without a word.
- Particles are sparse (3-6 alive at once) - a sprinkle, not a fountain.
